name: telegram-channel
description: Telegram channel bridge for pushing messages into a running Codex session.

interface.shortDescription: Bridge Telegram messages into the active Codex session.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local MCP channel server that polls a Telegram bot, forwards allowed chat messages into the current Codex TUI session, and exposes a reply tool for sending responses back to Telegram.
defaultPrompt: When a Telegram channel message arrives, answer it with telegram_reply after doing the requested work.
